messages:
Ava Lin: FYI — ran into a routing gap for POCs that include multimonth commits + non-standard discounts. CPQ currently sends these to Sales Ops, but we need Deal Desk review for pricing exceptions > 15% or any legal special terms.
Ben Carter: Can you paste the CPQ field that's triggering the current route?
Ava Lin: It's this right now: `Special_Pricing_Flag__c` (boolean) + `Discount_Percent__c`. routing rule only checks flag, not commit length.
Priya Sharma: That explains it. We need a compound rule: if Commit_Months__c >= 6 OR Discount_Percent__c > 15 -> route to Deal Desk. Otherwise standard Approval Queue.
Marcus Lee: +1. Also surface `Security_Questionnaire_Required__c` — if true, force Deal Desk + Security review. Some enterprise POCs include an SSA.
Ben Carter: Agree. Proposal for new mapping:```salesforce
CASE(
  WHEN Commit_Months__c >= 6 THEN 'deal-desk'
  WHEN Discount_Percent__c > 15 THEN 'deal-desk'
  WHEN Security_Questionnaire_Required__c = TRUE THEN 'deal-desk-security'
  ELSE 'standard-approval'
)
```
Ava Lin: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) update CPQ price rule and 2) add a routing audit log field `Deal_Route_Reason__c` so downstream ops can troubleshoot.
Priya Sharma: For the audit log, suggest values: ["commit-length", "discount-threshold", "security-qa", "manual-override"].
Marcus Lee: SLA question: what turnaround do we expect from Deal Desk? Sales needs a hard SLA to promise POCs. Current vague "ASAP" kills momentum.
Ben Carter: Sales ops recommend: Standard SLA = 24 business hours for <= $50k ARR and no security questionnaire. Escalation SLA = 48 hours for > $50k and <= $250k. For > $250k or any legal term changes, 72 hours + rush path if requested.
Ava Lin: Can we enforce SLA in the routing UI? i.e., set `Approval_SLA__c` and surface in the Deal Desk queue.
deal-bot: created ticket DD-1129 for CPQ rule change (owner: @Ben Carter) — link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1129 :white_check_mark:
Ben Carter: I'll take ownership of DD-1129. Plan: patch CPQ in sandbox tomorrow, run unit tests, then deploy to staging.
Priya Sharma: One more: special term templates — we should attach a template ID in SF when route = deal-desk so Legal can pre-fill. Field: `Requested_Template_Id__c`.
Ava Lin: Good call. Marcus, can you update the internal routing doc and add examples?
Marcus Lee: On it. I'll add the flow diagram and a table of CPQ fields + example values. ETA EOD.
Ben Carter: Quick sample SOQL to validate routing in sandbox:```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Commit_Months__c, Discount_Percent__c, Security_Questionnaire_Required__c, Deal_Route_Reason__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'oppty-1234'
```
Ava Lin: Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben -> DD-1129 + deploy plan; Marcus -> doc + examples; Priya -> template ID list + values; I'll coordinate stakeholder signoff and test POC after staging.
Priya Sharma: I'll send the template list before lunch. :thumbsup:
Marcus Lee: Doc link (draft) https://docs.redwood.com/sales/deal-routing/draft — comments welcome.
Ben Carter: I'll post test results in this thread once sandbox patch is verified.
Ava Lin: If no objections we'll ship mapping tomorrow. :rocket:
